content.text:
**Finding submitted: COMPLIANT (preferred position) — no redline proposed.**

Summary of the review:

| Location | Assessment |
|---|---|
| § 2(a) Grant (p0022, p0024) | **Meets preferred.** No restriction on our business; instead an express freedom to acquire, develop or license competing software/services, qualified only by TrueLink IP non-infringement and existing § 10 confidentiality duties. The "ordinary course of its business of… consumer finance receivables" wording is a scope-of-licence limit on our use of TrueLink's Interface, not a covenant governing what businesses we operate or products we build. |
| § 8 Covenants of Client (p0051–p0058) | No restrictive covenant — compliance, notification, access control, content warranties, anti-spam only. |
| § 8(d) (p0054) | Only "non-competition" reference; it limits **TrueLink's** licence to exploit our Credit Data, i.e. runs in our favour, so not flagged (direction check). |
| §§ 7, 10, 12–30, Exhibits A–B | No field-of-use, territory, exclusivity or minimum-commitment restriction binding us. |

Noted in the rationale rather than redlined: the "Non-Competition Agreement" cross-referenced in § 8(d) is neither defined nor attached. That is a diligence item — we should obtain it before signature and confirm it contains no covenant restricting Mortgage Logic's own mortgage or web businesses; if it does, this rule would need re-running against that instrument.
